items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: I lived across the street from him and I used to listen to him.

ctx.x: One's named Duncan and the other one's named Edward. They're twins, they play, they're good Reed men. They play saxophone. They, uh, play with bands, you know, different outfits around town. Sometimes Larry. And Larry's had a good band, you know, he had his band around that time too. He started back in that time. I lived across the street from him and I used to listen to him. Then I'd rehearse him practically two or three times a week. And his brother John used to play trumpet and I used to listen to him quite a…
Has Larry got a pretty good age on him by how old is he, you think?
